facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: positive isolation verification failure on P-3222

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the identification of every energy source for the task on P-3222 and M-3222 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on P-3222 and M-3222 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on P-3222 and M-3222 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in applying and verifying an isolation, specifically applying locks, tags and personal danger tags. P-3222 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the identification of every energy source for the task was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 29 November 2025 an incident occurred on P-3222 and M-3222 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during commissioning of replacement equipment, releasing electrical energy held as HV switchgear.
